exemption.reason: Not reviewed, and deliberately so: this is the first mapping of trial 10's slice, written as step 2 of #262, and step 3 of the same issue is the blind second mapping that reviews it. Recording anything else here would claim a review the trial has not run. `legacy` is the wrong word and is used for the reason examples/srd-52-conditions/review.json already records: it is the only exemption kind that names a tracking issue, and `non-semantic` needs a reviewed map to depart from, which a first mapping does not have. The map is trial evidence and is used for nothing downstream -- there is no map-package.json, nothing packs it, and no engine consumes it. The blind second mapping should look hardest at four things this mapping's own report names as unsettled: whether a column cell is an entry or a mapper's cut of a row (35 of the 135 entries are cells or contiguous groups of cells, and the contract's answer to distributed meaning is that an entry needing two places is two entries); whether `ib2-vapour-pressure-limit` and `ib3-vapour-pressure-limit` state rules at all when read apart from the coded row above them, which is the H1 strain; whether the conflict recorded under `what-an-ib-code-reaches` is a contradiction or a general rule its own paragraph qualifies; and whether the seven ambiguity verdicts are the right seven.
